title: Pulse report type
description: One anonymous-poll result as a typed page. Emitted mechanically by pulse-report: per-question averages from the Signal zone's k-anonymous aggregation. The data_source field says where the answers came from; segments below the k threshold are suppressed and carry no average.

status.description: Content lifecycle state. Mechanical reports are emitted `active`: deterministic tool output, not model prose.

survey.description: The survey name; also the page's place under pulse/.

data_source.description: Where the answers came from. Simulated runs say so plainly; never present simulated data as a real survey.

seed.description: RNG seed of a deterministic simulated run. Absent on real polls.

flows.description: Protocol flows: how many respondents started and how many completed every step.

average.description: Mean Scale5 score. Null when the segment is suppressed.

suppressed.description: True when the segment has fewer than k unique respondents; the average is withheld.

questions.description: One row per question and segment: the k-anonymous aggregate the Signal zone returned.

last_updated.description: RFC 3339 timestamp the report was emitted. Deterministic runs omit it.

confidence.description: Certainty of this page's content. Mechanical reports normally omit it.

citations.description: Pinned path@commit evidence refs (non-edge; interim until llm-wiki#8).

superseded_by.description: Id (preferred) or slug of the replacement page

x-wiki-types.pulse-report: One anonymous-poll result — team signal as a typed page
